# Gipsy.Dev — Adam Fairuz Akmal Aryaguna

> Portfolio website of Adam Fairuz Akmal Aryaguna (Gipsy.Dev), a Fullstack Engineer, Web Developer, and AI Engineer based in Malang, Indonesia. Built with React, Vite, and Tailwind CSS featuring a Midnight Editorial design system.

The site showcases projects, professional experience, certifications, and contact information. All content is in a single-page application format.

## Main Sections

- [Home](https://gipsy-dev.me/#home): Hero section with name, role, and introduction
- [About](https://gipsy-dev.me/#about): Bio, education timeline, skills, and technical expertise
- [Projects](https://gipsy-dev.me/#projects): 9 software projects including Socrapper, RightToBeForgotten, Threads Content Automation, StockPP, PasarNgalam, SentinelIoT, FruitCheck, RemindMe, IT Solution, and Gipsy.Dev portfolio
- [Experience](https://gipsy-dev.me/#experience): Organizational roles at HMPSTI VOKASI UB and DPM Vokasi Universitas Brawijaya
- [Certifications](https://gipsy-dev.me/#certifications): 21 professional certifications in AI, Data Science, Cloud Computing, Programming, and more
- [Contact](https://gipsy-dev.me/#contact): Contact form and social links

## Projects

- **Socrapper**: Social media sentiment scraper covering 9 platforms with keyword-based sentiment analysis
- **RightToBeForgotten**: Blockchain-based consent management with Zero-Knowledge Proofs on Polygon
- **Threads Content Automation**: AI-powered personal branding system with multi-agent pipeline
- **StockPP**: LSTM Deep Learning stock price prediction with real-time charts
- **PasarNgalam**: E-commerce platform for local MSMEs in Malang
- **SentinelIoT**: Real-time IoT monitoring dashboard for fire/gas hazard detection
- **FruitCheck**: AI-powered fruit freshness detection using CNN
- **RemindMe App**: Smart task reminder with cross-device sync
- **IT Solution Website**: Modern company profile with responsive design

## Technical Skills

- Frontend: React, Vue, Next.js, Tailwind CSS, Three.js, GSAP
- Backend: Node.js, Laravel, Python, FastAPI
- AI/ML: TensorFlow, PyTorch, Gemini API, Claude API
- Database: MySQL, PostgreSQL, Supabase, MongoDB
- DevOps: Docker, GitHub Actions, Railway, Vercel
